title: Filter labels on other reports read as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure at least three locations are open to you: the test location, a second location and a third location, so that the Location filter has several options to tick.
  • Open Reports > Parts Velocity in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Location filter (it lets you tick several options).
  2. Tick every option.
  3. Close the filter and read its label in the toolbar.
  4. Open the same filter again.
  5. Untick options until exactly two remain ticked.
  6. Close the filter and read its label in the toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The filter opens with its options.

Step 2:

  • Every option is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The label reads "All" followed by the filter's own word, as before the release (for the Location filter, "All locations").

Step 4:

  • The filter opens again.

Step 5:

  • Two options are ticked.

Step 6:

  • The label reads the count and the filter's own word, as before the release (for the Location filter, "2 locations").
  • It does not list the two option names the way the new Sales Type filter does.
